normalization_discrepancy.cause: Original Python prototype computed Float32 statistics; canonical JVM deliberately computes Double statistics then Float32 output. Same full-utterance Wav2Vec2 formula, different floating rounding, amplified by dynamic quantization.
normalization_discrepancy.disposition: Use actual JVM outputs/metrics as canonical acceptance evidence. Identical normalized model input yields exact raw frame-ID and transcript parity on allfour clips. No input/window/merge/CTC pipeline defect found.

Host Linuxx86_64/JDK21/Kotlin1.9.23target17/ORT1.20CPU, not actual Android ABI,2GBphone,microphone or clinical validation.
